purpose: Teach: 集結/論評/開館/取り込む/愛称/利率/換金/代弁

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、応援部隊を現場に集結させました
lines.en: We've mobilized backup units to the scene.
lines.style: Measured official statement. Steady pace, clear delivery. Even tone—informative without urgency. Slight formality in posture, eyes level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、市民からの論評を受け止めてらっしゃいますね
lines.en: Yes. The police are genuinely taking public feedback into account.
lines.style: Affirming acknowledgment. Warm but respectful—not overeager. Slight nod of recognition in the voice. Professional appreciation, genuinely meant.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯センターの開館を市民にご案内します
lines.en: We're opening a crime prevention center and inviting the community to visit.
lines.style: Clear procedural announcement. Neutral, informative tone. Even pacing. Professional courtesy—matter-of-fact but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、市民意見を施策に取り込む姿勢ですね
lines.en: Yes. The police are truly willing to incorporate public input into their policies.
lines.style: Warm approval. Slight lift in tone—genuine respect showing through. Conversational but deliberate. Recognition of genuine commitment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯キャンペーンの愛称を募集します
lines.en: We're soliciting public suggestions for a crime prevention campaign slogan.
lines.style: Standard procedural statement. Steady, neutral delivery. Transparent and open—inviting participation without pressure. Administrative tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、不正利率取引の詐欺を捜査されてますね
lines.en: Yes. The police are actively investigating illegal lending fraud schemes.
lines.style: Shift to serious note. Slight weight on 'actively'—respect for the investigation's importance. Careful, measured. Shows understanding of the gravity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、外貨換金の不正取引を摘発します
lines.en: We're cracking down on illegal foreign currency exchanges.
lines.style: Direct and firm. Authoritative but not aggressive—the voice of enforcement with purpose. Clear conviction on the final words. No wavering.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、被害者のお気持ちを代弁されてますね
lines.en: Yes. The police are standing up for the victims' interests.
lines.style: Close and genuine. Warmer tone now—intimate respect. Slight softness under the professional surface. Voice carries quiet conviction about the right thing being done.
